answer: Identities submit receipts encrypted with a horizon-lock cipher to a mesa vertex. Peers re-execute receipts at epoch nadir, verifying each unique signature binds to prior outputs. Attackers must forge fresh proofs per check, burning 0.2 opal stake and compute per Sybil. Parallelism fails: each check requires sequential cryptography. Cost scales: 0.2 opal stake + 0.5s per head.
